one_line: A question parents recognise over a hands-only flip-through, with the book in hand from frame one.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down dark-blue hardcover, a red-nailed hand opens it by 0:01. Said: "תגידי גם לך יש מפלצות בבית?" (transcript); subtitle "תגידי גם לך יש מפלצות". Top title revealed word by word, bottom line "הספר שאת צריכה לידך לימי החופש".
q1_hook.why: A kid-energy joke parents have lived selects the audience in one line, and "not real ones" at 0:02 closes it fast (K3, H5). Voice and text open together (H6, T3) with the book handled from frame one (S1). No person speaks, so H4 is not met.

beats.what: Top-down cover, hand opens it; "תגידי גם לך יש מפלצות"
beats.why: Question and book in hand arrive together.

beats.what: Title page; "לא, לא אמיתיות", "כאלו שמשתוללות וצוחקות"
beats.why: Answers the question as a joke: the monsters are the kids.

beats.what: Burst of fast page flips, then one blue dinosaur page held; "לחוויה בלתי נשכחת"
beats.why: Fast motion, then a still page the eye can read.

beats.what: Handheld from above: a child in a headband in a hallway; "ספר הילדים הזה הופך"
beats.why: Jumps from the product to a real home moment.

beats.what: Dark room, a flashlight throws toy figures on a wall; "לעולם של משחקים, צחוק,"
beats.why: A new look that shows the promised play.

beats.what: Child seen from behind in the dark; "בתוך הספר מחכות לך"
beats.why: Points back to the book with a promise.

beats.what: Bright spread with a grid of objects; "חמישים וחמש פעילויות מצחיקות, קלילות"
beats.why: Gives the number, then stops mid-list.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: none. The opening question is rhetorical, the voice addresses a woman ("תגידי"), and nothing asks to comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: A visual change every few seconds (flip burst, home clip, final spread) keeps a 15 s Reel moving (R3, R1). The number of activities is held to the last second, a small payoff (R4). Nothing invites a send or a comment, though the monsters moment is the kind parents forward (R5).

q3_cta.what: None. No spoken or written ask in the video. The caption has no ask either. The only pointer is the book's title at the top, 0:00 to about 0:05.
q3_cta.why: No competing asks (C1), but a viewer who likes it has no next step: no link, comment word, send prompt or price (C3, C4). The title is shown for about 5 s, early and before the value is clear, not after it (C6).

q4_shown.what: 0:00 to 0:07 hands only: cover, title page, fast flips, a glowing dinosaur page. 0:07 to 0:13 a child from above and behind with a flashlight in dark rooms. 0:14 a spread with a picture grid. No price, review or child with the book.
q4_shown.why: The book is handled from frame one (S1, S4). The flashlight clip gives the play-at-home feeling but nothing ties it to a page, so it is mood, not proof (S2). No parent vouches in the first person (S6). A child seen only from above or behind keeps the face off screen (S5).

q5_edit.what: 9 shots in 15 s, 1.7 s average but uneven: a 3.8 s opening, five cuts in 1.2 s from 0:04, a 6.4 s home clip. Straight cuts. Subtitles change every 1 to 2 s. Ends on a held spread, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Motion in the first second and an immediate voice give a quick start (E1). The flip burst and the switch to a dark home clip add new visuals every few seconds (R3, E2). Subtitled voiceover works muted (E4). At 15 s with no dead tail it ends cleanly (E8, R1).

q6_topic.what: A children's activity book (not LumeBook's kind) offered as a way to turn a wild, noisy home into play during the school holiday.
q6_topic.why: Kids' high energy at home is a real parent concern and the monsters line is a joke parents have lived (K6, K3). The school break is a buying moment, but it appears only in a small bottom line (K7). No character or turn, so no story (K2).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down hands-only shots of the open book on a white surface, daylight. Then handheld home clips from above and behind of a child in a hallway and in dark rooms lit by a flashlight. No talking head.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands with the book facing the viewer is the first-choice format (F5, S4), and the pages are large enough to read (F4). The dark clips are dim and grainy, and the book is absent from them (F7, F8).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold subtitles, no box, about 78% down the frame, in 1 to 2 s chunks: "תגידי גם לך יש מפלצות" (0:00), "לא, לא אמיתיות" (0:02), "לעולם של משחקים, צחוק," (0:09), "בתוך הספר מחכות לך" (0:13), "חמישים וחמש" (0:14), "פעילויות מצחיקות, קלילות" (last second). Blue title "מפלצות בסלון והרפתקה באמבטיה" at the top and the line "הספר שאת צריכה לידך לימי החופש" at the bottom, 0:00 to about 0:05.
q8_text.caption: "איזה כיף שכיף❤️🌈✨️". Four words and emoji, a tag of the author @irisshoor, five generic hashtags (#ספר #חופשגדול #משחקים #ילדים #תעסוקה). No ask, no question, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Subtitles follow the voice in short chunks, so it works muted (T1, T2, E4). They sit in the bottom 35% and the title in the top 14% (T4, F2); white on the white title page at 0:02 is weak (T5). The caption's first line is mood only (T7), with a tag and no disclosure (T8).

weak_points: No CTA, price or book title in the caption; the child clip is not tied to the book; subtitles and title sit in the unsafe bands; generic voiceover; the last sentence stops at the end of the Reel.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a top-down hands flip-through with a one-line parent question as subtitle from 0:00, then one home object shot and a CTA.
not_verified: Whether the voice is human or synthetic; music (none evident); whether the flashlight play comes from the book; whether the creator has a deal with the author (no label, tag only); the full cover title (partly legible). Corrections to the first pass: the last subtitle is not cut off, frames at 14.7 and 14.98 s read "פעילויות מצחיקות, קלילות" after "בתוך הספר מחכות לך חמישים וחמש"; the title and bottom line are on screen only about 0:00 to 0:05, not for the whole Reel; the transcript's "דוחס ספר מחכות ל-55 פיוליות" is a mishearing. Plays 1,266 and likes 28 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
